Table S9c. Second-chromosome run settings

Chromosome 22 runs are the sweep settings; chromosome 2 runs use the same individuals. EUR + AFR is also run on chromosome 2 at chromosome 22's vg = 0.01, as a sensitivity analysis to total signal variance in the presence of a small (205-person) AFR discovery sample. Changing vg also changes the genuine signal strength and PRS-CS's shrinkage, so the comparison does not isolate any single mechanism.
